tasks.title: Model explicit waivers, accepted risks and policy identity
tasks.goal: Make closure policy reviewable without hiding gaps.
steps: Define exact fact/artifact-need waiver with rationale, approving authority, scope and revisit condition.
Represent accepted risk separately and compute versioned meaningful policy identity.
Implement readiness evaluation as an explicit profile operation over the neutral analysis.
positive_cases: Authorized waiver remains visible beside its still-missing artifact need.
negative_cases: Waiver without scope/authority and contradictory dispositions refuse.
Risk acceptance cannot turn unavailable observer into satisfied evidence.
acceptance: Policy output cites exact inputs and every applied waiver/risk.
Changing policy meaning changes applicability, not historical facts.
tasks.safe_stop: Retain neutral gaps while policy decisions remain explicit.

tasks.title: Separate structural checks from optional semantic advice
tasks.goal: Provide advisory extension plumbing without an LLM quality gate.
steps: Define an optional explicitly invoked advisory finding with rubric version, fingerprint and disposition.
Keep semantic ambiguity/testability advice out of pure queries and hard neutral terminality.
positive_cases: Deterministic checks work with no advisory provider.
Explicit advisory result can be retained with its rubric/provenance.
negative_cases: English regex or fixed five-question count cannot become a semantic gate.
Missing adviser does not make otherwise complete structural validation fail.
acceptance: Reports label deterministic findings and optional advice distinctly.
Query counters show no hidden provider invocation.
